JazakAllah, Question: Assalkm, 1)What is miqdar of Awwabin? is it correct to recite only 2 rakat? 2) If we could'nt recite 4 rakat sunnat before Zohar fardh, is it neccesary to recite it after fardh? if so then what niyat is to be done ? i.e. of Kadha or otherwise. JazakAllah, Answer ID: 16402 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1548/1553/M=1430) Awwabin is six rak?ah, one will not get the complete reward by performing only two rak?ah. (2) If one cannot perform the four sunnah muakkadah before Zuhr, he should perform the same after the fardh is over if the Zuhr time allows it and it will be enough to think that he is performing the four rak?ah sunnah muakkadah of Zuhr. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
